entities.name: Nelson Mandela
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anti-apartheid revolutionary who spent 27 years in prison before becoming South Africa's first Black president (1994–1999). His leadership in dismantling apartheid through negotiation rather than retribution became a global model for peaceful transition.
